data.name: AlIyad
data.gender_notes: AlIyad is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root letters 'A.L.Y.D' which mean 'to be high-ranking, exalted, or elevated'. This name is mentioned in the Hadith and is attributed to several companions of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name AlIyad carries the meaning “Exalted, Elevated” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlIyad usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, elevated and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Striving for excellence and righteousness in all aspects of life.
data.etymology: AlIyad belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Elevated.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlIyad total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
